description: Source code implementing the rx::TextureStorage9 class and its derived classes for managing D3D9 textures, including 2D and cube textures, with functions for surface retrieval, mipmap generation, and copying between textures.

classes.name: TextureStorage9
classes.description: Abstract base class for managing D3D9 textures, providing interface for usage, format, and data management.

classes.name: TextureStorage9_2D
classes.description: Derived class for managing 2D D3D9 textures, including surface access, render target creation, and mipmap generation.

classes.name: TextureStorage9_Cube
classes.description: Derived class for managing cube map D3D9 textures, including surface access, render target creation, and mipmap generation.

classes.name: TextureStorage9_EGLImage
classes.description: Derived class for managing textures backed by EGLImageD3D objects.

methods.name: GetTextureUsage
methods.description: Determines D3D usage flags based on internal format and render target status.

methods.name: isRenderTarget
methods.description: Checks if the texture is used as a render target.

methods.name: isManaged
methods.description: Checks if the texture pool is managed.

methods.name: supportsNativeMipmapFunction
methods.description: Indicates if native mipmap functions are supported (returns false).

methods.name: getLevelCount
methods.description: Returns the number of mipmap levels.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Stub for setting texture data (not implemented).

methods.name: getSurfaceLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the surface for a specific mipmap level.

methods.name: getRenderTarget
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a render target for a specific level.

methods.name: generateMipmap
methods.description: Generates mipmaps by filtering from source to destination level.

methods.name: getBaseTexture
methods.description: Creates the base D3D texture if not already created.

methods.name: copyToStorage
methods.description: Copies texture data to another TextureStorage9 object.
